graders.name: flag-renamed
graders.criteria: The sync command's flag is now named `debug` with shorthand `v` (e.g. BoolVarP(&..., "debug", "v", ...)); there is no remaining `verbose` flag name. Renaming the Go variable is optional; the help text keeps its meaning.

graders.name: docs-updated
graders.criteria: README and CONTRIBUTING now refer to `--debug` where they mentioned `--verbose` (CONTRIBUTING may keep `-v` alongside it); neither instructs users to use the old `--verbose` flag (a note that it was renamed is fine), and nothing else in them changed in meaning.
